study.question: The original joint model g0-r0039-context_product has click AUC 0.668457307890924; the validation incumbent g3-r0034-joint_aligned has 0.668473871997858. The trajectory records g3-r0030-click_only and g3-r0030-aux_context_blocked both at 0.6678548720585206, versus g3-r0030-joint_replay at 0.668457307890924. These are same-seed observations, not independent repetitions. The failed replication path g3-r0039-centered_replay (0.6676314512972833) differed from earlier centered replay; g3-r0040-task_direct/aggregate_direct and g3-r0041-collected_task32/collected_task64 motivate retaining joint collection, aggregate centering and FP64 reduction instead of conflating numerical paths. In g3-r0047-orthogonal_native, orthogonal transfer gave 0.6682887435699238, parallel_native 0.6678178597099826, centered_native_bridge 0.6682972490126902 and blocked_native_bridge 0.6678548720585206. The g3-r0048 and g3-r0049 native replays reproduce the same seed, not seed robustness. g3-r0049-orthogonal_native_positive/negative give 0.6682887435699238/0.667765764501977 (gap 0.0005229790679468); g3-r0049-orthogonal_reassigned_positive/negative give 0.6683229112207776/0.6680188315050506 (gap 0.0003040797157270). Neither replacement beats the incumbent. Reassigned positive beats native positive by only 0.0000341676508538, which is not established as meaningful. The replacement is norm matched and click orthogonal, but its overlap with native O was not constrained or measured (candidate_diagnostics=not_requested). Both replacement signs exceeded the historical blocked reference in this seed. Thus neither assignment dependence nor the source of its residual sign effect is resolved. Question: does the native auxiliary direction carry useful directional information beyond occupied-row centering, norm and instantaneous click orthogonality, when a replacement is explicitly orthogonal to the native direction as well?
study.hypothesis: The native O direction contains useful shared-context information. The paired replacement R may retain some native overlap, so its residual sign asymmetry is not a clean test of information orthogonal to O. Removing the spans of both centered click K and native O from R, and norm matching the remainder Q to O, should attenuate the positive-minus-negative AUC gap and reduce replacement-positive performance relative to native positive if native overlap explains the prior sign effect. This is a falsifiable surrogate-backward attribution hypothesis, not an asserted mechanism, scalar objective, or new architecture.

study.proposed_difference: Add one stateless FP64 helper: center K and O, form unit K basis and an O basis orthogonalized against K in two modified Gram-Schmidt passes; center inherited R, remove both basis projections in two passes; normalize resulting tangent to ||O||_F. If O=0 or the pre-normalization tangent norm is below 1e-6*||O||, Q=0; this predeclared degeneracy gate has no fallback direction. Otherwise Q is zero on empty rows, occupied-row centered, orthogonal to both K and O, and norm matched before the inherited cast. Four standalone sources differ only in literal CONFIG: direction native/paired_tangent crossed with sign aligned/reversed. Every arm computes O, R, Q and inherited norm helpers. This manipulates direction, not a pure example permutation or parameter-space projection.
predictions: Native positive/negative bridges should reproduce g3-r0049-orthogonal_native_positive/negative exactly under the frozen seed and numerical path. Failure blocks cross-generation attribution; retain the failure and investigate before any automatic retry.

Primary predeclared contrast: D_native=AUC(native_positive_bridge)-AUC(native_negative_bridge), D_tangent=AUC(tangent_positive)-AUC(tangent_negative); predict |D_tangent|<|D_native| if residual native-direction overlap explains the earlier replacement sign asymmetry. Report both signed gaps and D_native-D_tangent without claiming significance from one seed.

Secondary directional prediction: native_positive_bridge outperforms the arithmetic mean of the two tangent AUCs. The tangent average is a factorial summary, not a deployable model or an unbiased estimate of generic regularization.

At fixed state every arm has identical forward outputs, parameters (expected 32,192,421), RNG/buffers, true-label losses and private task/scorer/item gradients. Full eval including odd/remainder and empty-history batches follows the inherited route. Training-only helper adds cost equally; inference needs no additional work.

Host numerical gates on synthetic finite inputs: all-empty, one occupied row, zero K, zero O, collinear R, mixed occupancy, and ordinary dense cases. Check Q is zero where required, finite, occupied-row centered, and (when nondegenerate) norm matched and orthogonal to K and O. Target normalized FP64 residuals <=1e-10; measure post-cast residuals with dtype-aware bounds (FP32 <=1e-5, BF16 <=5e-2). Also compare native cotangents to ancestor, private parameter gradients, frozen running-state updates, probability alignment and mask perturbation invariance. These are required future host checks, not locally executed results.

Record the R-versus-O cosine, pre-normalization tangent/||O|| ratios, degeneracy rate, post-cast norms/dots, parameters, allocated GPU seconds/wall time, peak memory, throughput/p50/p95, all task AUC/Logloss and fixed history-length slices with sample/positive/negative counts. Do not assert these diagnostics exist when the host does not collect them.
falsifiers: With replay and numerical gates passed, a tangent sign gap as large as or larger than the native gap would fail the proposed attenuation prediction; an advantage of tangent over native positive would contradict superiority of native O in this contrast.

If both tangent signs retain the benefit over the historical blocked reference, native-direction overlap is unnecessary for that observed benefit. A same-generation blocked arm and paired seeds would still be needed to discriminate structured optimization from task information.

A substantial degeneracy rate (predeclare >1% of nonzero-O batches), norm mismatch or large post-cast geometry error invalidates the equal-norm directional interpretation. Report outcomes and do not silently loosen the 1e-6 gate or tolerances.

One frozen seed cannot establish robust auxiliary utility or absence of utility. Deterministic replays do not establish seed replication, parameter-space orthogonality or beneficial interference removal.
alternative_explanations: Sparse repeated-ID gradient accumulation and Adagrad change geometry after the row-context intervention; neither K orthogonality nor equal norm implies parameter-gradient orthogonality or equal adaptive steps.

The paired replacement still depends on auxiliary labels through O, its magnitude and the projection basis; Q is not independent noise. A tangent sign effect could reflect higher-order label information, deterministic row order or optimizer geometry.
Training paths diverge after the first update, so same-state gradient identities do not guarantee identical later private gradients, buffers or loss values.

Changed numerical precision previously altered trajectories. FP64 and the single inherited cast are retained, but native bridge failures or unmeasured pre/post-cast residuals would prevent mechanistic conclusions.
Removing both spans and renormalizing changes within-row magnitudes and embedding scatter. This is a constrained direction replacement, not an isolated proof of example assignment.

Many prior validation comparisons and one seed permit selection optimism. The best incumbent remains selected by validation; no held-out data are available here. The offline delayed-feedback history and category/brand auxiliary-label semantics limit deployment interpretation.
